english: Scoring 2 <arc Arc /> Weapon Precision Hits against non-<arc Blinded /> Combatants within 2 seconds while Armor Charge is active consumes 1 Armor Charge and <arc Blinds /> enemies within 7 meters for about 8.5 seconds.

source.text:
Upon scoring 2 Arc Weapon Precision Hits against Non-Blinded Combatants within 2 seconds of each while Armor Charge is active:

Consumes x1 Armor Charge.
Inflicts blind to enemies within 7 meters for ~8.5 seconds.
